name: Personal Budgeting and Expense Tracker CLI
description: Evaluates clean extraction of core functional requirements, actor, and explicit local SQLite constraints for a personal finance CLI.

input_state.user_prompt: I want to build a local command-line personal finance and expense tracking tool in Python 3.11 using SQLite. The tool must let individual users log expenses with amount, category, date, and description. It must allow users to view monthly spending summaries grouped by category. Finally, it must allow exporting expense reports to a CSV file.
input_state.project_context: Standalone CLI utility. Local file storage only. No external cloud dependencies.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Log expenses with amount, category, date, and description
View monthly spending summaries grouped by category
Export expense reports to CSV file

pass_criteria: Captures all 3 functional requirements, extracts user actor, identifies Python/SQLite constraints without inventing unstated cloud or web dependencies.

name: Webhook Dispatcher & Retry Service
description: Evaluates extraction of webhook ingestion, HMAC signature verification, exponential backoff retries, and sub-200ms latency NFR.

input_state.user_prompt: We need a webhook delivery service. The system should receive outgoing webhook events from internal microservices, verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures, and deliver HTTP POST payloads to subscriber endpoint URLs. If an endpoint fails (returns non-2xx or times out), the service must retry delivery using exponential backoff up to 5 attempts before marking it failed. Deliveries must achieve p99 latency under 200ms.
input_state.project_context: Internal microservice. High throughput event dispatching.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Receive and ingest outgoing webhook events from microservices
Verify HMAC-SHA256 payload signatures
Deliver HTTP POST payloads to subscriber endpoint URLs
Exponential backoff retry logic up to 5 attempts on failure or timeout

pass_criteria: Extracts HMAC verification, HTTP POST delivery, exponential backoff retry, and p99 latency metric.

name: Markdown Knowledge Base Desktop App
description: Evaluates local desktop note-taking app extraction with hierarchical folders, live preview, full-text search, and strict offline constraints.

input_state.user_prompt: Develop a desktop markdown note-taking app for technical writers. The app must allow writers to create, edit, and delete markdown notes organized in hierarchical folders on their local disk. It must provide live side-by-side markdown preview rendering, and a full-text search bar that indexes note content. All data must remain strictly on the user's local disk with no network transmission.
input_state.project_context: Desktop application. Privacy-first local file architecture.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Create, edit, and delete markdown notes
Organize notes in hierarchical folders on local disk
Live side-by-side markdown preview rendering
Full-text search bar indexing note content

pass_criteria: Identifies Writer actor, folder hierarchy, live preview, search, and strict local disk privacy constraint.

name: Serverless Contact Form & Lead Capture

input_state.user_prompt: Create a serverless backend function to handle contact form submissions from our marketing website. It must accept visitor inquiries containing name, email, subject, and message. It must validate inputs, verify Google reCAPTCHA v3 tokens to reject spam bots, and send an email notification to the sales team using SendGrid. It should also persist the lead to a database table.
input_state.project_context: Lightweight serverless endpoint. Triggered via HTTPS POST.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Accept and validate visitor inquiries with name, email, subject, message
Verify Google reCAPTCHA v3 tokens to block spam bots
Send email notifications to sales team via SendGrid
Persist lead data to database table

pass_criteria: Extracts form validation, reCAPTCHA v3 check, SendGrid email notification, and lead storage.

name: Telehealth Patient Appointment & Video Consultation Portal
description: Evaluates multi-role telehealth portal extraction with doctor scheduling, WebRTC video consultation, and strict HIPAA PHI encryption rules.

input_state.user_prompt: We are designing a telehealth SaaS platform. Patients must be able to search for certified doctors by medical specialty, view real-time appointment availability, and book consultation slots. Doctors must be able to manage their schedule, accept or reschedule appointments, and access patient medical intake summaries. When an appointment starts, both patient and doctor must join an encrypted WebRTC video room with an integrated chat box. The system must comply with HIPAA regulations and encrypt all Protected Health Information (PHI) at rest and in transit.
input_state.project_context: HIPAA-compliant healthcare SaaS. Integrates WebRTC for peer-to-peer audio/video.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Search for doctors by medical specialty and view availability
Book consultation slots and manage appointment lifecycle
Doctors manage schedule, accept/reschedule appointments, and review patient intake summaries
Encrypted WebRTC video consultation room with integrated chat

pass_criteria: Captures Patient and Doctor roles, doctor search, appointment booking, WebRTC room, and HIPAA/PHI security constraints.

name: E-Commerce Multi-Warehouse Inventory & Order Routing
description: Evaluates proximity-based warehouse order routing, split shipment logic, barcode pick-and-pack, and atomic stock decrements.

input_state.user_prompt: Build an inventory management and order fulfillment engine for an online retailer with 4 regional warehouses. When a customer places an order, the system must check inventory levels across all 4 warehouses and route the order to the warehouse closest to the shipping address that has all items in stock. If no single warehouse has all items, it must split the order into minimal split shipments. Warehouse workers must receive pick-and-pack lists on barcode scanners, and inventory counts must decrement atomically upon pack confirmation. Low-stock alerts must trigger when SKU counts fall below reorder thresholds.
input_state.project_context: Distributed inventory coordination across 4 physical fulfillment centers.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Track inventory levels across regional warehouses
Route orders based on warehouse proximity and in-stock inventory
Split orders into minimal shipments when no single warehouse has all items
Barcode pick-and-pack workflows for warehouse workers
Atomic inventory count decrements and low-stock threshold alerts

pass_criteria: Correctly models warehouse routing, split shipments, barcode pick-and-pack, atomic decrements, and low-stock alerts.

name: Continuous Delivery Pipeline Incident Alerting Dashboard
description: Evaluates GitHub webhook ingestion, MTTR and deployment frequency metrics, Slack alerts with log links, and p95 latency targets.

input_state.user_prompt: We need an engineering incident dashboard that monitors our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. The service must ingest GitHub deployment webhook payloads, parse pipeline status (success, failure, timeout), and calculate team deployment frequency and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). When a main branch deployment fails, it must automatically dispatch an urgent incident alert to the relevant Slack channel with direct links to the failing build logs. Engineering managers must be able to view 30-day velocity charts and MTTR trends. The dashboard API must respond with p95 latency under 300ms.
input_state.project_context: Internal developer platform tool. Integrates with GitHub Webhooks and Slack Incoming Webhooks.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Ingest GitHub deployment webhooks and parse status (success, failure, timeout)
Calculate deployment frequency and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
Automated urgent Slack alerts for main branch failures with log links
30-day velocity charts and MTTR trend visualization for managers

pass_criteria: Extracts GitHub webhook ingestion, MTTR calculation, Slack alerting, velocity dashboard, and 300ms latency metric.

name: Corporate Expense & Invoice Multi-Tier Approval Workflow
description: Evaluates tiered financial approval routing (<$1k, $1k-$10k, >$10k), PDF upload, and immutable audit logs.

input_state.user_prompt: Develop an enterprise invoice approval system for accounts payable. Employees submit invoices by uploading PDF receipts and entering expense line items. Invoices under $1,000 require approval from their direct Team Manager only. Invoices between $1,000 and $10,000 require approval from both Team Manager and Department Director. Invoices exceeding $10,000 require additional approval from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). All approval and rejection actions must be immutably recorded in a tamper-evident audit log with timestamps, user IDs, and rationale notes.
input_state.project_context: Enterprise financial workflow. Strict financial governance and auditing rules.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Submit invoices with PDF receipts and expense line items
Threshold-based approval routing (<$1,000, $1k-$10k, >$10k)
Manager, Director, and CFO approval actions
Immutable tamper-evident audit log with timestamps and user IDs

pass_criteria: Accurately extracts all 4 corporate actors, the 3 approval tiers, PDF receipt handling, and immutable audit logging.

name: High-Frequency Algorithmic Cryptocurrency Arbitrage Engine
description: Evaluates L2 WebSocket ingestion across 3 exchanges, sub-5ms dual triangular execution, risk slippage guards, and emergency kill-switch.

input_state.user_prompt: Design a high-frequency cryptocurrency arbitrage trading engine connecting to Binance, Coinbase, and Kraken via raw WebSockets. The system must ingest order book depth updates at L2 granularity, detect price discrepancies exceeding a configurable basis point threshold across exchange pairs, and trigger dual triangular arbitrage orders within 5 milliseconds. If market liquidity evaporates or slippage exceeds 0.05%, the risk management guard must instantly abort execution and cancel open legs. Traders must have a kill-switch UI to halt all trading activity immediately. The engine must support automatic WebSocket reconnection with state resynchronization upon network dropouts.
input_state.project_context: Mission-critical, ultra-low latency trading infrastructure. Capital risk exposure requires zero-fault safety guards.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Ingest L2 order book depth updates via WebSockets from Binance, Coinbase, Kraken
Detect cross-exchange price discrepancies exceeding basis point thresholds
Trigger dual triangular arbitrage orders within 5 milliseconds
Risk management guard aborting on liquidity loss or slippage > 0.05%
Emergency kill-switch UI to instantly halt all trading activity
Automatic WebSocket reconnection and state resynchronization

pass_criteria: Extracts 3 exchange feeds, sub-5ms triangular execution, slippage safety guard, kill-switch, and auto-resync.

name: Cold-Chain Pharmaceutical Logistics & IoT Fleet Tracking
description: Evaluates IoT BLE/GPS ingestion every 30s, 2-8°C corridor alerting, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 audit logging, and offline mobile checkpoint sync.

input_state.user_prompt: We require a cold-chain logistics monitoring platform for temperature-sensitive vaccines transported across international borders. Refrigerated transport trucks are equipped with BLE temperature sensors and GPS trackers that beacon telemetry every 30 seconds. The platform must continuously ingest telemetry, verify temperature stays strictly within the 2°C to 8°C corridor, and calculate current vehicle ETA. If temperature breaches the threshold for more than 3 consecutive readings, the system must trigger immediate push notifications to the Fleet Dispatcher and the Receiving Hospital Pharmacy, and log an excursion incident for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 audit compliance. Drivers using the mobile app must be able to log transit checkpoints in offline mode, with automatic queued synchronization once cellular coverage resumes.
input_state.project_context: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 regulated pharmaceutical transport. Hardware IoT beacons in remote zones with intermittent connectivity.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Ingest BLE temperature and GPS beacon telemetry every 30 seconds
Monitor 2°C to 8°C temperature corridor and calculate vehicle ETA
Trigger push alerts on 3 consecutive breaches to Dispatcher and Pharmacy
Log excursion incidents for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
Offline mobile checkpoint logging with automatic queued synchronization

pass_criteria: Extracts 30s telemetry, 2-8°C corridor, 3-breach excursion alerts, FDA Part 11 logging, and offline mobile sync.

name: Multi-Party Cross-Border Legal Contract Redlining & e-Signature
description: Evaluates collaborative redlining canvas, clause locking, SHA-256 digests, 2FA OTP, and eIDAS / ESIGN Act audit certificates.

input_state.user_prompt: Architect a legal contract negotiation and e-signature platform. Contract Authors upload master agreements in DOCX format, which the platform converts to a collaborative redlining canvas. Multiple legal reviewers from different organizations must be able to propose tracked changes, insert contextual legal comment threads, and resolve revisions. Once all clauses are agreed, the document locks against further editing and compiles into an archival PDF/A document. The platform generates an immutable SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the final document. Signatories authenticate via two-factor SMS/email OTP to apply e-signatures. A comprehensive audit certificate containing sign timestamps, IP addresses, and hash proofs must be attached to the final executed agreement to satisfy eIDAS and ESIGN Act requirements.
input_state.project_context: Enterprise LegalTech. Requires compliance with US ESIGN Act and EU eIDAS regulations.

expected_functional_requirements.concept: Upload DOCX agreements and convert to collaborative redlining canvas
Track changes, contextual comment threads, and resolution workflow
Lock document against edits and compile into archival PDF/A
Generate immutable SHA-256 cryptographic digest of final agreement
Authenticate signatories via 2FA SMS/email OTP to apply e-signatures
Attach eIDAS and ESIGN Act audit certificate with timestamps and IP addresses

pass_criteria: Identifies legal roles, redlining, clause locking, SHA-256 digest, 2FA OTP signature, and eIDAS/ESIGN compliance.
